{{Top|leg}}
The '''Troxan language''' was the native language of the [[Troxan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It had both a spoken and written form. Troxan diplomatic pouches included messages in both Troxan and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="YDR 2">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', Chapter 2.</ref>
